name: dynamic-resolution-steady-simple
description: DYNAMIC-RESOLUTION-STEADY (R7-AG) simple rung. The flag is on by default in Simple. The scenario harness runs at DSF 1, where the dynamic-resolution ladder has one rung and the controller is inert (a DPR-1 viewport is identical either way, measured in docs/research/lights-gpu-bound-2026-09-25.md §11), so the rung drives the app's OWN controller module in the page with the M4 2400x1800 frame trace §11 measured: the floor holds vsync, the 1.125 rung misses one frame in ~13 at a vsync median. With the flag's value as the steady input, the marginal rung must be held under 10 % of motion time, never climbed past, and backed off at least 16 s between probes. It also walks the living room with a held camera gesture and screenshots it, to show the flag leaves the DPR-1 render untouched. Control arm: dynamic-resolution-steady-off.json (?ff=dynamicResolutionSteady:off), which must show the R7-AF behaviour (the marginal rung passes its median test, so the controller climbs past it into 1.25).

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setManualHour(21); s.setLightsMode('on') })()

steps.name: assert-flag-on-by-default
steps.eval: (() => { const f = window.__store.getState().featureFlags; if (f.dynamicResolutionSteady !== true) throw new Error('dynamicResolutionSteady should default ON in Simple, got ' + f.dynamicResolutionSteady); if (f.dynamicResolution !== true) throw new Error('dynamicResolution should default ON, got ' + f.dynamicResolution); return 'ok' })()

steps.name: controller-on-measured-trace
steps.eval: (async () => { const m = await import('/src/scene/dynamicResolution.ts'); const steady = window.__store.getState().featureFlags.dynamicResolutionSteady === true; const L = m.dprLadder(1, 2); const d = m.initialDynResState(L.length); let t = 10000, n = 0, last = d.motionLevel, at1 = 0, frames = 0, above = false; const probes = []; while (t < 130000) { n++; const lvl = d.motionLevel; const dt = lvl === 0 ? 16.7 : lvl === 1 ? (n % 13 === 0 ? 33.3 : 16.7) : 33.3; t += dt; m.stepDynamicResolution(d, L, { now: t, dtMs: dt, moving: true, recording: false, steady }); if (d.motionLevel !== last) { if (d.motionLevel === 1 && last === 0) probes.push(t); last = d.motionLevel } frames++; if (d.motionLevel === 1) at1++; if (t > 11000 && d.motionLevel >= 2) above = true } const r = { steady, share1125: +(at1 / frames).toFixed(3), probes: probes.length, firstGapS: probes.length > 1 ? +((probes[1] - probes[0]) / 1000).toFixed(1) : null, above, changes: d.changes }; console.log('DRS trace ' + JSON.stringify(r)); if (!steady) throw new Error('simple rung expects the flag on'); if (r.share1125 > 0.1) throw new Error('marginal rung held too long: ' + JSON.stringify(r)); if (r.above) throw new Error('climbed past the marginal rung: ' + JSON.stringify(r)); if (r.firstGapS !== null && r.firstGapS < 16) throw new Error('re-probed within 16 s: ' + JSON.stringify(r)); return JSON.stringify(r) })()

steps.name: pose-living
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(11, 7); l.setYaw(0.07); l.setPitch(0); window.__three.invalidate(); return 'ok' })()

steps.name: gesture-walk
steps.eval: (async () => { const sig = await import('/src/scene/cameraMotionSignal.ts'); sig.beginCameraGesture(); const t0 = performance.now(); await new Promise((res) => { const step = (now) => { const e = now - t0; window.__walkLook.setYaw(0.07 + 0.4 * Math.sin(e / 600)); window.__three.invalidate(); if (e < 2500) requestAnimationFrame(step); else res() }; requestAnimationFrame(step) }); const r = window.__dynamicResolution?.(); sig.endCameraGesture(); console.log('DRS dsf1 ' + JSON.stringify(r)); if (r && r.active) throw new Error('DSF 1 must leave the controller inert, got ' + JSON.stringify(r)); return 'ok' })()

steps.name: pose-living-again
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(11, 7); l.setYaw(0.07); l.setPitch(0); window.__three.invalidate(); return 'ok' })()
